content: वह्निः [वह्-निः <ls>Uṇ. 4. 53</ls>] .²1 Fire; अतृणे पतितो वह्निः स्वयमेवोपशाम्यति <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²2 The digestive faculty, gastric fluid. .²3 Digestion, appetite. .²4 A vehicle. .²5 The marking-nut plant. .²6 Lead-wort. .²7 A sacrificer, priest. .²8 A god in general. .²9 An epithet of the Maruts. .²10 Of Soma. .²11 A horse. .²12 A draught animal. .²13 The number ‘three’. .²14 The mystical <ab>N.</ab> of the letter र्; रकार.
